title: Names differing only by case stay three distinct fields under AS_IS
rationale: The default naming strategy must not fold case, and generateUniqueKey collision set must be case-sensitive. Three spellings of the same word in one object is the cheapest way to pin both. This is the good-input arm of the naming-strategy drill: it must pass while the LOWER_CASE fixture must fail.
catchesBugClass: Accidental case folding anywhere in the key path - a case-insensitive collection used for the collision set, a Locale-sensitive toLowerCase leaking out, or a default naming strategy change.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch Turkish-locale damage, because applyNamingStrategy is never invoked under AS_IS. More importantly it cannot catch the downstream consequence: Spark resolves column names case-insensitively by default, so LOSSLESS here is not "safe".

predicted.detail: No escaping is triggered, the collision set is case-sensitive, AS_IS skips transformKeys entirely, and all three round-trip exactly.
